flags: All three NCDOT guidebook cache files contain identical extracts ending before Mission Crossing’s chapter despite their page-fragment URLs. The official chapter’s scenic rationale, exact Cranberry start and Old Turnpike Road spur cannot be checked. Route description instead follows cache 27, which starts the byway at Elk Park.

Dropped unsupported current claims: Old Turnpike Road began as a game trail, charged six days of labor, and carried escaped Union prisoners and Confederate draft evaders during the Civil War. Retained the title but limited the moment to the documented 1891–92 turnpike incorporated into NC 194; the specific named spur’s identity remains unverified.

Dropped the school’s World War II closing date: cache 19 instead says it continued into the 1990s, without sufficient corroboration. Church construction dates differ: cache 05 says 1926, cache 19 says about 1924. Used only the explicit 1924 cornerstone date.
Mast General Store is retained as a documented National Register historic landmark. Its 1882 construction and 1883 opening are distinguished. The slogan was omitted as unnecessary, not unsupported.
No live truck-routing check was possible; checked records review of the cached route page. Current story and moments contain no motifs.
